scope.method: six single-slot Candidate100 additions; paired 1,000-repetition date-block bootstrap comparisons; unchanged canonical uncertainty settings

result.decision: Do not retain or combine a rotation-continuity addition from this screen.
reasons: Active-player and starter overlap had interval-separated harm in their tested heads.
Minute-share overlap in the margin head had only a negligible favorable point estimate and its paired 95 percent interval crossed zero.
Minute-share overlap in the total head had no point gain.
The redundancy review found no exact or near-duplicate inputs, so non-selection reflects the paired screen rather than alias duplication.

limitations: This is an opened-label development screen, not independent predictive validation.
Canonical final scoring and model promotion were not run.
No site wiring, package build, or deployment changed in this milestone.
